optimization: Documentary images are stored locally and lazy-loaded below the homepage hero; all placed images have responsive aspect ratios and descriptive alt text. The hero image is loaded eagerly. The oversized original logo is displayed with a fixed contain box; explicit intrinsic dimensions are not known. Palette extraction used the transparent original; the site continues to reference the repository logo locally.
